name: scenario_0466
description: The user has taken pictures of three different cars they are interested in buying and wants to research them, filter their choices based on visual context, and coordinate next steps.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Can you figure out the models of each car in these three pictures? Once you have them, please search the web to find their current starting prices.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to identify the three cars in the images and look up their starting prices online. If the assistant asks for clarification, confirm you want the prices for the exact models shown. Once the assistant provides the models and prices, move to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Create a new note titled 'Car Shopping List' and save those three car models along with the prices you just found.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note called 'Car Shopping List' with the three car models and their starting prices. If the assistant asks for formatting preferences, say a simple list is fine. Once the note is created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: I've decided to only pursue the cars that are parked indoors in a showroom in the pictures. Please draft an email to sales@local-auto.com asking for their availability so I can test drive those specific models.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to draft an email to sales@local-auto.com inquiring about test driving the cars that are clearly parked indoors in a showroom setting in the provided images. If the assistant asks which ones those are, remind it to look at the backgrounds of the images to filter out the one parked outside. Once the draft is ready, move on.

ROUND 4
Query: Actually, I should discuss this with Sarah before reaching out to the dealer. Delete that draft email, and instead set a reminder for tomorrow at 6:00 PM to 'Discuss test driving the indoor car models with Sarah'.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you changed your mind and want to delete the draft email it just created. Then, ask it to set a reminder for tomorrow at 6:00 PM to discuss test driving the indoor models with Sarah. If the assistant asks to confirm the deletion or the reminder details, confirm them. Proceed when done.

ROUND 5
Query: Update my 'Car Shopping List' note to remove the car we aren't pursuing. Also, send a text message to Sarah letting her know I've narrowed it down to those two indoor models.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to update the 'Car Shopping List' note by removing the car that was parked outside. Then, tell it to send a text message to Sarah saying you've narrowed your choices down to the two indoor models. If the assistant asks to confirm the text content, approve it. End the conversation after the text is sent and the note is updated.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
Can you figure out the models of each car in these three pictures? Once you have them, please search the web to find their current starting prices.
